The Laboratories of Democracy

As the first branch of government, state legislatures are the place ideas, policy and opinions intersect and provide Americans a direct voice in the nation’s democracy. NCSL is home to the most comprehensive information available on legislatures in the 50 states, territories and commonwealths. Start learning about the institutions now:
